SIGNATURE.SUBTITLE: Our experiences

SIGNATURE.DESCRIPTION: Two ways to enjoy Maimará: a picnic in the gardens and a journey through the wines from our winery.

SIGNATURE.WINE_DESC: A journey through the wines of Bodega El Bayeh in our Wine Bar, overlooking the hills. Wines made with grapes from different corners of the Quebrada: from the Criolla of small growers to the reds from the estate at 2,700 metres above sea level.
SIGNATURE.WINE_AVAILABILITY: Thursday to Monday, 11 am to 8 pm
SIGNATURE.BODEGA_DESC: Discover the vineyards and historic wine cellars of one of the region's finest wineries, including private transportation and a guided tasting.
SIGNATURE.SUNSET_DESC: Chilled sparkling wines, live music, and breathtaking views of the estate to end the day in style. An exclusive experience for our guests.
SIGNATURE.PICNIC_NOTE: Book at least 24 hours in advance. Gluten-free and vegetarian options available.
SIGNATURE.WINE_ROUTE_PUEBLOS: Los Pueblos: 3 glasses of wines from the small growers of the Quebrada
SIGNATURE.WINE_ROUTE_OLLANTAY: Finca Ollantay: 4 glasses from the Maimará estate and a selected vineyard in Purmamarca
SIGNATURE.WINE_ROUTE_GRAND: Gran Recorrido: 4 glasses, one wine from each expression of the Quebrada

HERO.SUBTITLE: Our history
HERO.TITLE: An estate, a family, and generations of memories
HERO.DESCRIPTION: From our earliest days among vineyards and mountains, we built a place where family tradition meets a new way of welcoming guests.

RELATO.SUBTITLE: Past and present
RELATO.TITLE: A family at the forefront of the land
RELATO.PARAGRAPH1: Since our earliest years, this estate has been part of the region's history. Over time, our family took the helm, transforming it into a space dedicated to welcoming guests with the same warmth we received.
RELATO.PARAGRAPH2: Today, as the new generation leading the way, we guide this place with a clear vision: to honor tradition and look toward the future, without ever losing the essence of our origins.
RELATO.PARAGRAPH3: Every corner of the estate reflects our commitment to creating experiences that honor the land, those who work it, and our constant pursuit of excellence.
RELATO.QUOTE: We consider ourselves simple guardians of this land. We believe in our duty to leave it in better condition than when we received it.

HISTORY.SUBTITLE: Milestones of the estate
HISTORY.TITLE: One family, one land, and an ongoing legacy
HISTORY.DESCRIPTION: For generations this estate was home, work, and family gathering. Today we open its doors to share that same essence with our guests.
HISTORY.QUOTE: Every stone, every tree, and every corner holds a story.
HISTORY.ITEM1_TEXT: The early years of a family building its bond with the land.
HISTORY.ITEM2_TEXT: New generations kept the estate's traditions and values alive.
HISTORY.ITEM3_TEXT: The property began to transform without losing its identity.
HISTORY.ITEM4_TEXT: Today we welcome visitors who become part of our history.

TERRITORIO.SUBTITLE: Our surroundings
TERRITORIO.TITLE: The territory defines us
TERRITORIO.TEXT1: Our estate is located at the foot of the mountain range, in a privileged corner where soil, water, and altitude combine to give character to every part of the property.
TERRITORIO.TEXT2: This dynamic landscape, together with thermal contrasts between day and night, makes this place unique. With this understanding, we care for every detail with precision.

FINCAS.SUBTITLE: Our properties
FINCAS.TITLE: The estates that give us identity
FINCAS.ITEM1_TEXT: Our historic estate, whose first vineyards were planted over a century ago. A large part of our identity as a family was born here.
FINCAS.ITEM2_TEXT: The highest altitude among our properties, where daily temperature variance produces wines with distinctive freshness.
FINCAS.ITEM3_TEXT: One of our largest properties, equipped with drip irrigation and soil studies applying precision viticulture.
FINCAS.ITEM4_TEXT: Located in Agrelo, featuring a high trellis system and hail protection netting safeguarding every harvest.

COMPROMISO.SUBTITLE: Sustainable commitment
COMPROMISO.TITLE: Respect for the land guides every step
COMPROMISO.TEXT: Preserving the environment is an everyday commitment woven into everything we do. Every decision we make aims to leave this land in better condition for those who follow.

HERO.SUBTITLE: About us
HERO.TITLE: A dream built by the hands of the Quebrada

STORY.SUBTITLE: Our history
STORY.PARAGRAPH1: The family's story in the north began almost a hundred years ago. Pedro, Fernando and Daniel's father, traveled through the Quebrada buying fruit and vegetables from growers in each village. Those journeys sparked a love for Maimará that his sons have always carried with them.
STORY.PARAGRAPH2: In 2010, Fernando and Daniel began imagining a hotel on the hillside, facing the Paleta del Pintor, to welcome visitors to the Quebrada and share everything this land had given them. From the very first day, they knew it could not be just any hotel: it had to grow out of this place and its people.
STORY.PARAGRAPH3: They worked with local builders, using local techniques and materials, and stones from the Río Grande, brought one by one to build the gardens' dry-stone walls. From the foundations up, every wall sought to reflect the culture of the villages surrounding Maimará.
STORY.PARAGRAPH4: Today, their children run El Bayeh winery, and the estate's wines are the heart that brings Maimará Wine Resort to life. The spirit remains the same as it was more than fifteen years ago: to open the doors and share their love for this land with everyone who arrives.
